spec.description: How accurate past hourly temperature forecasts have been: forecast-minus-actual error by lead time over the selected range (melon location, openweathermap exporter). Normal: RMSE ~2-2.5 °C at 6-24 h lead and ~1.5 °C at 47 h; mean error within ±0.6 °C.

spec.expr: sqrt(avg by (job, instance) (avg_over_time(((openweathermap_forecast_temperature_celsius{forecast_type="hourly", offset_hours="6"} offset 6h - on(job, instance) group_left openweathermap_current_temperature_celsius)^2)[$__range:1h])))
